Ambiguity.description:
An unresolved choice (9.2): {kind, candidates, default if any}. Each
candidate names the dimension it is about, with its resulting edits and
what moves.

Boundary.description: A rectilinear boundary given explicitly or taken from spaces.

choice.description: The dimension this option is about (a constraint, opening or occurrence id).

moved.description: Entities other than the moved one that move under this option.

constraint.description: The constraint later in processing order.

residual.description: How far it is from agreeing, when it has a value.

the defaults catalog value with source Proposed (6.4).

edge height: then derived from them.

elevation.description: Null is 0: the slab top at the storey floor.

join_priority.description: Null is 0; ties go to the lowest wall id.

layers.description: Left to right; null takes the catalog interior stud wall.

top.description: Null is the storey's floor-to-floor height.

Motion.description:
How far a move goes: a signed delta along the axis, or the target
coordinate of the moved reference (Q-39).

Moves an occurrence's center along one axis (a wall-mounted item only
along its host).

edit.description: The constraint the user picked for a ReferenceSemantics ambiguity.

reference.description: The wall's own face or center whose coordinate `motion` names.
